audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record: C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\encompass_health_2026.json. The checker reports structure OK and 80 of 80 quotes exact. Every figure, section reference, period and party name in the record matches the dump and the page images (pages 1 to 10 viewed; 11 to 13 are pricing definitions and fees, read in the dump only). No figure or status was changed.

First auditor's doubts, as resolved:
1. Stated on partial figures (accordion, negative_pledge, permitted_distributions, permitted_indebtedness, permitted_loans): kept stated. The brief reserves by_reference for a row the term sheet addresses "only" by pointing elsewhere, and each of these gives a figure the row asks for. The lines say the rest is in the Precedent Credit Agreement, but the rows will not be highlighted yellow.
2. fc_other "Other: none": kept stated. "The following financial covenants (the 'Financial Covenants')" matches the style guide's own example of closing words. The outer covenant list is still "including, without limitation", so a third covenant in the Precedent Credit Agreement cannot be excluded from this document alone.
3. conditions_subsequent: kept by_reference. The term sheet does address post-closing delivery (insurance endorsements; perfection "subject to post-closing relief as mutually agreed"), but with no deadlines.
4. select_definitions: kept stated (net leverage formula and pro forma rule are set out; the EBITDA definition itself is by reference).
5. other_covenants: kept by_reference (names only, open list, terms by reference). A reader who treats the list of names as all the row asks for could mark it stated.
6. Not-a-commitment statement and the guarantee of hedging / bank product obligations: both now printed (see changes). The ranking point (consent to subordinate the liens) stays in the note.

What the document cannot resolve:
- The 15% aggregate limb of the immaterial-subsidiary definition: alternative test or additional cap. The term is "to be defined".
- How guarantees and junior-debt payments are restricted; the term sheet is silent and the cross-references are pointers only.
- Which transactions are Limited Condition Transactions (undefined); the rule sits in Permitted Acquisitions only because no template row covers conditions to credit extensions.
- "Limited liability transactions" on page 9 is recorded as printed; "liability management" is an inference.
- The growing component of every grower cap, all other baskets, all event-of-default thresholds and cure periods, the change in control trigger, reporting deadlines and the Borrower's jurisdiction of incorporation are not in the term sheet.
- The term sheet is undated, and the Addendum I pricing grid is headed "Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio" while the text says "Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio".

Not recorded because the template has no row for it: pricing and fees (margin grid 1.00% to 2.00% for SOFR loans, commitment fee 0.20% to 0.25%, 0.125% fronting fee, 2.00% default interest), the Required Lenders threshold (more than 50%) and the conditions precedent.

doc.title: Marketing Term Sheet for $1,000,000,000 Senior Secured Revolving Credit Facility
doc.notes: Truist Securities marketing term sheet (for discussion purposes only; expressly not a commitment) for a new $1.0bn senior secured revolving credit facility for Encompass Health Corporation; no date is printed and no lender commitments are given. The terms are on pages 1-9 in a label / value layout and Addendum I (pages 10-13) holds pricing and fees. It is not an amendment with existing and proposed columns, but the facility refinances, and is to be documented on the basis of, the Precedent Credit Agreement (Sixth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated October 7, 2022). Guarantor exclusions, collateral, covenants, events of default and the incremental facility are to be consistent with or 'substantially the same' as that agreement, and the term sheet shows only the changes, mostly increases to the fixed dollar component of grower baskets (new amount and the amount it replaces).
